runtimeFacts.menuBackground: theme ambient waves in dark, ribbon in light; app hidden while menu is open
runtimeFacts.wallGrowthMsPerTile: difficulty.divisor * 23; easy = 1 ms with up to 32 steps per update
runtimeFacts.streak: increments per completed wall, resets on damage or new game, persists across levels

commands.deploy: npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name balljump-game --branch main --commit-dirty=true
commands.firebaseRules: cd ../Botanica Studio/botanicstudio; npx firebase-tools deploy --only firestore:rules --project botanicstudio

security.runtimeNetwork: none for core gameplay; Firebase SDK/APIs loaded on demand for auth/ranking
security.runtimeDependencies: none for the game; Firebase JS SDK 10.14.1 loaded on demand
security.csp: default-src 'none'; allowlisted inline assets, gstatic Firebase SDK and Firebase APIs; see _headers
security.secretsPolicy: Firebase apiKey is public; never commit service accounts, private keys, tokens or cookies

profileCustomization.nicknameNormalization: lowercase, diacritics removed, non-alphanumerics collapsed to hyphen
profileCustomization.photo: optional 160x160 JPEG data URL, max 90000 chars, no Firebase Storage

firebase.writes: owner only; monotonic scores; server timestamp

visual.ambientBackground: inline SVG: blurred orange waves shifted right in dark mode, blurred orange ribbon in light mode

invariants: index.html works offline via file:// for core gameplay
external network is limited to the pinned Firebase SDK and Firebase auth/firestore APIs
goal is 75 percent
player gains one life per completed level
share button remains removed
menu, tutorial, settings, death screen, profile editor and ranking remain available
site name is ted-io in the document title and main menu card
main menu uses the theme ambient background and hides the classic app while open
candy screen has a settings gear that pauses the timer and hides the difficulty section
Jogar opens a mode chooser with classic and candy; no duplicate mode button in the menu
settings include a 0-100 volume slider persisted in localStorage
tutorial can be opened from settings and returns to settings when closed
ranking documents store only name, optional photo, bestStreak, bestLevel, optional per-difficulty scores and server updatedAt
rankings are split by difficulty (easy, normal, hard, hardcore) plus an overall ranking
candy mode is a 8x8 match-3 with 100 levels, timer instead of lives and its own candy ranking
candy bombs explode a 3x3 area on swap and can chain; the candy screen shares the classic ambient background
candy ranking has streak, level and score categories and does not affect classic scores
profile photo is a validated data URL limited to 90000 chars and rendered without innerHTML
nicknames are unique via balljumpNicknames reservation; rename releases the old key in the same transaction
ranking reads require authentication and writes require owner UID with monotonic scores
security headers must stay compatible with the game and the OAuth popup
context docs must be updated with behavior changes
